instructions: Read each body under `## Review summaries (first look)` and journal any warranted note before review mutations.
Read every item marked `[edited since first look]`, including edited summaries and edited first-look bullets, before deciding whether to resolve a matching thread.
Journal key decisions or rejections with URLs or IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to a one-line outcome; run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_thread1 --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
